problem: The one-time pull_request bootstrap workflow used to land the trusted-base migration must not remain alongside the permanent trusted pull_request_target workflow, and the permanent governance gate must not require maintaining a second human GitHub account.

decision.rationale: Keep exactly one base-authoritative required evidence workflow while preserving autonomous development: governance changes require machine-readable evidence and previous-base validation, not a second reviewer.

official_docs.verified_constraint: GitHub recommends unique job names across workflows when those names are used as required status checks because duplicate names can create ambiguous results.

alternatives.reason: Conflicts with the owner's intended solo-agent workflow and creates an operational dependency unrelated to evidence quality.
Retains trusted-base policy, adversarial tests, evidence manifests and fail-closed classification without requiring another GitHub identity.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The temporary .github/workflows/pr-evidence.yml bootstrap workflow is deleted.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: PR diff deletes the bootstrap workflow.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The permanent trusted workflow remains base-authoritative and does not execute candidate policy code.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: pr-evidence-trusted.yml keeps separate trusted/candidate checkouts and executes validators from trusted/.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Governance and milestone progress no longer depends on a second human GitHub account.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Trust-boundary policy, decisions and PR template remove mandatory independent-human review.

automated: Permanent trusted workflow evaluates the candidate using policy from main; candidate policy tests cover autonomous milestone/governance behavior.
manual: Direct deletion from protected main was attempted and correctly rejected by the repository ruleset.

governance.trust_boundary_change: Removes the temporary candidate-controlled bootstrap workflow and removes the second-human dependency while preserving base-authoritative policy execution.
governance.bypass_analysis: The candidate still cannot make its own validator authoritative; governance changes require same-PR evidence and are tested by previous trusted policy. Reference diversity, diff classification and official-doc parsing checks remain enforced.
governance.rollback: Revert this PR to restore the previous mandatory-review rule or bootstrap workflow if the owner intentionally chooses that operating model later.

known_limitations: Repository ruleset strict/up-to-date enforcement remains a separate GitHub settings action tracked in issue #4.
